accounts.label: mule
accounts.rationale: High pass-through ratio with only three distinct payers and a single payee, combined with a device shared across five other accounts and a prior (pending) mule-lien decision in another case, strongly indicate mule behavior. The very low tainted share reflects a large balance but does not offset the structural mule indicators.
